Interior Centre provides interior design and contracting solutions for customers in Mymensingh. From planning and design to execution, we help transform spaces into functional and beautiful environments.

Why work with us

A local studio handling both the design and the build.

Design and contracting together

Planning, design and execution are handled under one roof, so a project moves from concept to completion without gaps.

Based in Mymensingh

Consultation-based planning

Customer-focused approach

Straightforward communication

Clear updates through planning, design and build, so there are no surprises along the way.

About Interior Centre

A local interior design and contracting studio

Interior Centre is a local interior design and contracting service located at Jubilee Ghat in Mymensingh, opposite Bipin Park.

The studio works with clients on both the design side of a project — planning how a space should look and function — and the contracting side, carrying that plan through to execution.

Every project begins with a consultation to understand the space and what it needs to do, before any design or construction work begins.
